basic_info.description: UNIQLO is a brand of Fast Retailing Co., Ltd., a leading Japanese retail holding company with global headquarters in Tokyo. UNIQLO is the largest of eight brands in the Fast Retailing Group, the others being GU, Theory, PLST (Plus T), Comptoir des Cotonniers, Princesse tam.tam, J Brand and Helmut Lang. With global sales of approximately 2.13 trillion yen for the 2021 fiscal year ending August 31, 2021 (US $19.4 billion, calculated in yen using the end of August 2021 rate of $1 = 109.9 yen), Fast Retailing is one of the world’s largest apparel retail companies. As the Group’s pillar brand, UNIQLO continues to open large-scale stores in some of the world's most important cities and locations, as part of its ongoing efforts to solidify its status as a global brand. Today the company has more than 2,300 stores in 25 markets including Japan. Driven by the concept of LifeWear, apparel that comes from the Japanese values of simplicity, quality and longevity, we offer unique products that become the building blocks of an individual’s lifestyle. We oversee the entire clothes-making process – from procurement of materials, product planning, development, design and manufacture, through distribution, retail and inventory management. Since the launch of the first UNIQLO Fleece item in 1998, we have continued to attract fans all over the world thanks to innovations such as HEATTECH, AIRism, Ultra Light Down, Ultra Stretch Jeans, and many more.

basic_info.description: FAST's journey began nearly four decades ago with a mission to promote industrialization in Pakistan and contribute towards the socio-economic uplift of fellow citizens. basic_info.name: Fast Escova
basic_info.description: A Fast Escova é uma franquia de salões de beleza com atendimentos sem hora marcada e que teve a sua primeira unidade inaugurada em outubro de 2018, em Goiânia. A franquia tem como objetivo oferecer atendimento rápido e descomplicado a mulheres que precisam de agilidade e qualidade. Destaca-se pela proposta ideal para quem vive em uma rotina repleta de compromissos, prioriza o autocuidado e deseja estar bem consigo mesma, sem perder tempo.Nem todo mundo quer ou pode passar horas no salão. Mas toda mulher merece sair se sentindo pronta para o dia ou para um evento especial. E a Fast Escova é sobre isso: valorizar o tempo da mulher, dar mais independência e liberdade para todas. Sem precisar marcar horário, sem ficar horas aguardando e sem surpresas na hora de pagar a conta. Mas com cabelos escovados, make, tratamentos e unhas feitas em tempo recorde.Com sua linha de produtos próprios, utilizados pelos profissionais nas unidades desde o início da franquia, no final de 2021 a marca estendeu essa linha para uma marca independente. Agora, além de produtos de uso profissional, também oferece versões que as clientes podem levar para casa, prolongando os cuidados com os cabelos. Os produtos estão disponíveis nas unidades franqueadas e em plataformas de vendas online.Hoje a Fast Escova conta com 235 unidades comercializadas e mais 80 em implantação, consolidando-se como a maior rede de escovaria da América Latina. Em apenas cinco anos, tornou-se uma das redes de franquias que mais cresceu no Brasil. Com valores focados no tempo e na beleza das mulheres, a Fast Escova também é um projeto que gera empregos, fomenta o empreendedorismo e transforma vidas por meio do franchising.A Fast Escova é um projeto ousado que alia os melhores produtos, serviços e profissionais especialistas para provar que a beleza pode ser descomplicada, rápida e com preço justo. Porque toda mulher merece ser linda todos os dias, e não só em ocasiões especiais!

basic_info.name: Fast Track
basic_info.description: Fast Track was the leading research and events company that created a network of the UK’s top private companies and entrepreneurs through publishing annual rankings in The Sunday Times. Hamish Stevenson founded the company in 1997 with cornerstone sponsorship from Sir Richard Branson and Virgin, with The Sunday Times as media partners; and he closed the company at the end of June 2021 due to the impact of the pandemic on future sponsorship revenues.Fast Track published six annual league tables and brought the founders and directors together at invitation-only networking awards events and alumni dinners, supported by sponsors.Over 25 years, Fast Track published 127 league tables featuring more than 5,800 companies, including nearly half of the UK’s c2,500 private companies with operating profits of over £3m, and hosted over 500 invitation-only events attended by 18,000 entrepreneurs and directors.The following six annual league tables will no longer be compiled and published by Fast Track with The Sunday Times:•Fast Track 100 - fastest-growing sales (£5m – £250m) – published for 24 years •Profit Track 100 – fastest-growing profits (sales £10m – £350m) – published for 22 years•Tech Track 100 - fastest-growing TMT sales (£5m - £50m) – published for 20 years•Top Track 100 – biggest sales (£750m - £20bn) – published for 19 years•Top Track 250 – mid-market growth (sales £115m - £750m, min 5% growth in sales or profits) – published for 16 years•International Track 200 – fastest-growing int’l sales (total sales £25m – £200m) – published for 12 years
